description: Extract representative alchemy bubble bonuses for testing the Bubble bonus root

extractions.label: daily_drip_final_bonus
extractions.expression: (() => { const raw = Number(idleon.getDNSM("AlchBubbles").h.LqdCap); const alchemyLevel = Number(idleon.getAttr("PixelHelperActor")[5].behaviors.getBehavior("ActorEvents_232")._GenINFO[87]); return raw * Math.max(Math.pow(alchemyLevel / 25, 0.3), 0); })()
extractions.description: Da Daily Drip effective final bubble bonus (AlchBubbles.LqdCap × ActorEvents_232._GenINFO[87])

extractions.label: diamond_chef_meal_count
extractions.expression: (() => { const meals = idleon.getAttr("Meals")[0]; return meals.reduce((count, level) => count + (Number(level) >= 11 ? 1 : 0), 0); })()
extractions.description: Diamond Chef qualifying meal count (Meals[0] entries at level >= 11; TalentCalc source 1.21 lines 104306-104313)

extractions.label: cropius_mapper_portal_count
extractions.expression: (() => { const players = idleon.getAttr("PlayerDATABASE").h; let opened = 0; Object.keys(players).forEach(id => { for (let i = 0; i < 13; i++) opened += Number(players[id].h.KillsLeft2Advance[251 + i][0]) < 1 ? 1 : 0; }); return opened; })()
extractions.description: Cropius Mapper opened World 6 portal count (PlayerDATABASE KillsLeft2Advance maps 251-263; TalentCalc source 1.21 lines 104439-104452)
